description: Belfast Cycle Map is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. The Department for Infrastructure (DfI) has carried out some research on the cycling infrastructure in Belfast. This information was collated from partners within the Department, Belfast City Council, Sustrans, Belfast Harbour Commissioners, open source mapping and local knowledge. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
